body_html:
The Johnson-Howe wedding reception was beautiful, classy, and FUN!  It was honestly the best Monday night wedding we could have asked for.  The bride and groom, as well as the catering staff were all on top of their stuff, and it went as smoothly as it possibly could have.  The bride and groom’s friends and family were awesome as well!  Once the dancing began it did not stop until we were done, it was great!  Congratulations to Heather and Logan Howe!

DJ Matt
